description: This Java class 'AssetEdgeProcessor' handles processing of asset-related messages from edges, including creating, updating, deleting assets, and converting edge events to downlink messages within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AssetEdgeProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of asset messages from edge devices, including creation, update, deletion, and conversion of edge events to downlink messages.

methods.name: processAssetMsgFromEdge
methods.description: Processes incoming asset messages from edge, handling creation, update, or deletion based on message type.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateAsset
methods.description: Saves or updates an asset based on the received message and manages relations and events.

methods.name: pushAssetCreatedEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes an asset creation event to the rule engine.

methods.name: convertEdgeEventToDownlink
methods.description: Converts an edge event into a downlink message to be sent to the edge device.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for an asset based on the message and existing data.

methods.name: getEdgeEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of edge event this processor handles, which is ASSET.
